name: Inclusion-Minimal Negative Classes of Orders 527 and 528
definition: Let $A=(Y_{267}\setminus\{236,492,1004,748\})\cup\{220\}$ be the certified $264$-word ample family rooted at $r=750$. The first example glues two disjoint-coordinate copies of $A$ at $r$. The second places the two copies on opposite shores of a fresh coordinate and joins their roots by its single edge.
parameters: The classes have respectively $527$ and $528$ concepts; the $527$ class has $24$ active coordinates and the bridge construction adds one coordinate to the separated presentation.
properties: Both classes are ample, negative for dismantlable ampleness, cornerless, positive under every coordinate reduction, and minimal among proper ample subfamilies. The $527$ class is a forbidden pc-minor. The $528$ class is not: projecting the bridge coordinate yields the negative $527$ class. The rooted input property used here is stronger than ordinary positivity: every proper ample $B\subsetneq A$ peels relatively to $B\cap\{r\}$, independently of the allowed corner-deletion choices avoiding $r$.
